lines.t: I am the Lord, and I will no more give myself to diversions.
lust to the cares and deceits of my flesh in this world i am the lord my heart it is the lord
my mind it is the lord my will it is the lord my flesh it is the lord
The whole of my body, even all I am
I give to the Lord
I am the Lord
Yeah, I pour out my life before the Lord
Even as he poured out his
Let me receive it in the name of my love
I call out in Yahushua's name
I ask to receive it
Yahushua, my life and my righteousness
I want your life
My Lord and my God, I am yours
Do with me as you please
According to the good pleasure of your will
I give myself away
Amen
Thank you.
Thank you.
